technique_name: Explain why there is an increase in online shopping.
description: The increase in online shopping is due to several factors including convenience, accessibility, the variety of products available, more competitive pricing, and improved customer service. Convenience is one of the major drivers of online shopping - with customers able to order what they need in the comfort of their own home.
